items.q: they said, “Hey Bruce, it’s Patti,” you know, his wife.

ctx.x: So I go wow, this is going to be great. Even later on I said, “Hey, you want to hear the jug too?” So he had me come in and he just wanted the tuba in some spots, and it was funny, like I’m a really good reader, and he had a — not a super hard whistle part, but just give me some time to learn it. Often I’ll say like give me a few minutes and let me write it down, so take after take I’ll know exactly what the notes are supposed to be instead of trying to remember. But we didn’t do it that way. But the whistle…
